implementationPlan.description: TDD red — src/project/project-reducer.test.ts. EXHAUSTIVE transition matrix: every (ProjectLifecycle state × project command/witness) cell asserted either allowed or rejected with the registry code + exact details — rejections use RuntimeError from @moe/contracts createRuntimeError, codes EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT (details actualVersion/expectedVersion), IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, ILLEGAL_TRANSITION (details aggregateKind/commandKind/sourceState) — NEVER an invented PROJECT_* namespace (createRuntimeError fails closed to UNKNOWN_ERROR for unregistered codes; read runtime-error-factory.ts + runtime-error-registry.ts FIRST for exact signatures/allowlisted detail keys; note RuntimeError deliberately carries NO free-form message — attacker bytes never reflected). Authorized matrix (design-cited, encode EXACTLY this): project.register only from nonexistent -> BOOTSTRAPPING (design 17.1 step 1); project.bind_repository BOOTSTRAPPING-ONLY, repeatable, records frozen repository observation, NO lifecycle change (design 1015-1016; READY/DEGRADED/QUIESCED reject ILLEGAL_TRANSITION — documented inference: design only authorizes it inside bootstrap); project.activate BOOTSTRAPPING -> READY requiring an activation witness whose typed fields reference store/driver, provider minimum profile, credentials, policy, signing key, artifact/backup paths, distribution manifests checks (design 1019) AND carry truthClass: RuntimeTruthClass — reducer rejects when truthClass is UNKNOWN or AGENT_REPORTED (rail: UNKNOWN never gains authority; activation requires DAEMON_VERIFIED or HUMAN_APPROVED); restore-quiesce witness READY|BOOTSTRAPPING -> QUIESCED with recoveryRequired: true facet on state (design 974 — the compound QUIESCED/RECOVERY_REQUIRED is lifecycle QUIESCED + boolean facet, NOT a fifth state); recovery-completion witness (recovery.complete, R3 decision, design 977) QUIESCED -> READY clearing recoveryRequired, truthClass HUMAN_APPROVED required. DEGRADED: NO entry and NO exit transitions exist anywhere in the design (doctor's DEGRADED at line 957 is doctor report vocabulary, not a project mutation) — the state stays REPRESENTABLE (it is in RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES.PROJECT) but UNREACHABLE, and every (DEGRADED, anything) cell rejects ILLEGAL_TRANSITION; contract comment flags this for a future design sync. Idempotency/version: every command carries commandId + expectedVersion; expectedVersion mismatch -> EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT with ZERO state change (deep-equal before/after); reducers have NO replay branch — the store decision ledger owns replay/conflict (single-slot replay detection is provably wrong: ordering makes it unreachable and same-ID-different-bytes would misclassify CORE-I9 conflicts) — commandId is echoed verbatim into every event so the ledger can do its job (this is how 'idempotency inputs are represented'). Seeded-PRNG property tests (hand-rolled xorshift32, NO fast-check, NO Math.random): random command sequences never reach DEGRADED, never resurrect from an unauthorized cell, always deep-frozen results (deep isFrozen walk), same seed -> identical trace. Run focused command, confirm RED.

implementationPlan.description: TDD red — src/goal/goal-reducer.test.ts. Exhaustive matrix over GoalLifecycle (RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES.GOAL) × commands/witnesses, same registry-code discipline as step 2. Authorized matrix (design line 278 + 1021, encode EXACTLY): goal.create -> DRAFT, requires project-READY witness reference (truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED+) and carries typed REFERENCES budgetAccountId + planningRunId (allocated by the caller/daemon per design 1021 — the reducer records the references in GoalCreated, it does NOT model budget arithmetic; do not claim 'allocates nothing': the event shape must let the daemon honor design 1021 atomically); initial-graph-activation witness DRAFT -> EXECUTION_ENABLED (activeGraphRevisionRef required, exactly-one-active-revision represented as a single non-null reference field); goal.close with acceptance-closure witness EXECUTION_ENABLED -> CLOSING — witness typed fields MUST include completionNodeAcceptedRef, acceptanceClosureRef, obligationsHoldRef, noPendingDraftOrSupersession: true, AND noCurrentPreparationGeneration: true (design 278 + 666: entry into CLOSING refuses while a preparation generation is current), truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED+; goal.close with zero-authority proof witness CLOSING -> COMPLETED (design 278 atomic proof; truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED+); combined single-command EXECUTION_ENABLED -> CLOSING -> COMPLETED when BOTH witnesses present (design 278 sentence 'If that proof already holds, one command may record EXECUTION_ENABLED -> CLOSING -> COMPLETED in the same transaction' — emits both events); qualification-invalidation witness CLOSING -> EXECUTION_ENABLED (PROOF_INVALIDATED reference, design 278); goal.cancel DRAFT|EXECUTION_ENABLED|CLOSING -> CANCELLED with authorization witness (fences subordinate authority — reference only); goal.reopen_as_revision allowed ONLY from COMPLETED|CANCELLED — returns successor-goal creation data (new goalId reference, predecessor linkage, generation increment) and NEVER mutates the old goal (old state returned unchanged; contract comment cites the inference from design 278 placement after 'COMPLETED and CANCELLED are terminal' for future design sync). Scheduling control (orthogonal GOAL_SCHEDULING): goal.pause(PAUSE_AFTER_CURRENT_STEP|DRAIN_AND_PAUSE) and goal.resume(->RUNNING) allowed in DRAFT and EXECUTION_ENABLED (design 366: no lifecycle restriction, pause blocks planner claims which exist from DRAFT via the PlanningRun); REJECTED in CLOSING with ILLEGAL_TRANSITION (design 278's exhaustive CLOSING allowed-operation list omits pause/resume — documented decision), rejected in terminals; scheduling changes never change lifecycle and vice versa (assert independence). Terminality: every mutation against COMPLETED|CANCELLED rejects except reopen_as_revision. Stale expectedVersion -> EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT, zero state change. Property tests (seeded xorshift32): unauthorized states unreachable, terminal absorption (once COMPLETED|CANCELLED, lifecycle never changes), deep-frozen everywhere, deterministic traces, and CLOSING can only exit to COMPLETED, EXECUTION_ENABLED, or CANCELLED. Confirm RED.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Invented PROJECT_*/GOAL_* error namespaces — REJECTED after verification: runtime-error-registry.ts already mandates EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT/IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT/ILLEGAL_TRANSITION with GOAL,PROJECT validSources and exact detail keys (aggregateKind/commandKind/sourceState); createRuntimeError fails closed to UNKNOWN_ERROR for unregistered codes, so a parallel namespace would collapse at the boundary. Core reuses the registry; granularity goes into allowlisted details. (2) Reducer-level idempotent-replay branch (lastAppliedCommandId) — REJECTED as provably broken: version check makes it unreachable, single slot misses delayed replays (design :735 requires the ORIGINAL result which a pure reducer cannot produce), and commandId-equality without request digest would misclassify CORE-I9 same-ID-different-bytes conflicts that decision-ledger.ts:150-157 handles via requestSha256. DoD 'idempotency inputs are represented' is satisfied by commandId carried on every command and echoed into every event; the store decision ledger is the sole replay authority. (3) DEGRADED transitions — verification proved NO design line authorizes any project-lifecycle mutation to/from DEGRADED (line 957 is doctor report vocabulary): state stays representable but unreachable, all cells reject, flagged for design sync. (4) fast-check dependency for property tests — rejected: hand-rolled seeded xorshift32 keeps zero new deps and full determinism. (5) Scaffold ownership — this is the FIRST packages/core task; scaffold included here and announced in #architects (msg-65670599736b) so 6 sibling core tasks don't re-scaffold. Plan verified by 2-agent adversarial workflow (design-fidelity vs D:/projexts/moes design doc, mechanics vs repo); 4 BLOCKERs folded in.

planningNotes.risks: (1) Witness truth-class floor is the rail-compliance mechanism: every witness carries truthClass; UNKNOWN/AGENT_REPORTED reject for proof-gated transitions (activation, closing, completion, recovery) — shape-valid but UNKNOWN-classed evidence must never move state. (2) pnpm-lock.yaml contention: @moe/skills (WORKING) adds its own importer block in this shared tree; a committed lockfile referencing an uncommitted importer fails --frozen-lockfile — step 1/7 carry the serialization rule (skills lands first, or coordinate in #general). (3) DEGRADED intentionally unreachable — QA may flag 'dead state'; the contract comment cites design lines 195+957 and the pending design-sync question; do not invent transitions to silence the matrix. (4) reopen_as_revision from COMPLETED|CANCELLED is a documented inference (design 278 sentence placement); successor is returned as DATA, never a second live aggregate. (5) Combined close emits two events in one result — event consumers must tolerate multi-event results. (6) Do not let matrix tests assert on error MESSAGE text (RuntimeError has none) — assert code + details. (7) Shared dirty tree: concurrent store decomposition + skills tasks; attribute red repo gates before acting (mem:gotcha-moe-wrapper-autocommit for auto-commit sweep).
